name: Fastino API Docs
description: Official Fastino documentation for GLiDE decision models, GLiNER extraction, inference APIs, and model fine-tuning.

markdown.instructions: Use https://docs.fastino.ai/llms.txt to discover and navigate pages. Use https://docs.fastino.ai/llms-full.txt when you need the complete documentation corpus. Use https://docs.fastino.ai/openapi.json as the source of truth for customer-facing routes. For GLiDE decision inference, call POST https://api.fastino.ai/v1/systemone with model fastino/GLiDE. Do not infer undocumented routes. Read API keys from FASTINO_API_KEY and never embed credentials in code, logs, or reports.
